Espacio acondicionado para sesiones de fotos, rodajes de contenido visual, catálogos y proyectos audiovisuales. Cuenta con iluminación y ambiente adaptado.

�️ Sala 4 – Plató de Podcast:

inv.desc_en: Unique opportunity for dance and fitness professionals! Spectacular premises for rent/sale, located at Calle Cafeto, 5 (Retiro / Pacífico district, 28007 Madrid). A spacious, versatile space perfectly equipped for a dance school or academy ("Yo Bailo"). Main features of the property: Large, open-plan area: 324 m² built with great spaciousness, ideal for housing several rehearsal/dance studios, a reception area, changing rooms, and bathrooms. Technical flooring: High-resistance floating floor/parquet adapted for the practice of all types of disciplines (salsa, bachata, contemporary dance, flamenco, ballet, urban, etc. ). Soundproofing and acoustics: Space acoustically conditioned to ensure optimal sound during classes without causing disturbances. Climate control and ventilation: Hot/cold air conditioning and ventilation system to maintain the optimal temperature at all times. Complete facilities: Separate changing rooms (female and male), restrooms, and a reception/waiting area for students. Light and ambiance: Zoned adjustable lighting, perfect for intensive classes as well as workshops and events.
